messages:
emma_sales: Heads-up — ACME wants to expand the POC. They now want: (1) data residency in eu-west-1, (2) run evals on 10k prompts incl. safety/regression, (3) extended logs retention 90d. Need pricing delta and timeline. @raj_solutions @devon_eng @maria_security

raj_solutions: Quick clarifying Qs — is the 10k prompt set new or replacing the prior 2k? Do they want parallel runs across model variants?

sam_acme: Sam (ACME): it's new. Core success metrics they require: 95% F1 on entity extraction evals, avg latency < 350ms p50, and no PII leakage above threshold. We'll share the prompt set and eval harness by EOD.

devon_eng: Private deployment + residency implies VPC + dedicated capacity. Rough engineering estimate: 4w infra setup (network, VPC endpoints, KMS), +1w integration, evals can run in parallel. 90d logs => S3 retention + lifecycle + access controls. Ballpark 5–6 weeks. cc @maria_security for KMS/controls

maria_security: For residency+retention we need: KMS keys in customer's AWS account (bring-your-own-key), audit log streaming to their SIEM, completed security questionnaire answered, and signed DPA for GDPR. Encryption in transit & at rest is standard. If customer restricts KMS policies we may need additional PS.

emma_sales: OK — Raj, please produce a pricing delta for these changes. Line items: Dedicated capacity (monthly), Onboarding (one-time infra eng), Extended retention (per GB/mo), Security integration (PS). Need ballpark by EOD tomorrow.

raj_solutions: Will do. Preliminary ballpark: Dedicated capacity ~ $12k/month for the requested capacity profile, Onboarding ~ $18k one-time, Retention ~$0.02/GB/mo, Security PS ~ $10k. I'll formalize and call out optional add-ons.

devon_eng: Note about eval compute: 10k prompts x ~300 tokens avg = non-trivial GPU time. If they want full regen or multi-variant runs, add ~6 GPU-hours per variant. Recommend offering a staged eval (main variant first) to control cost.

sam_acme: We can start against main model v1.1 only. If that passes we'll expand. We can accept staggered runs to smooth peaks.

emma_sales: Good. Let's lock the success criteria to the three items Sam listed. I'll update the SOW and loop in Legal for the DPA. @deploybot please create the kickoff reminder once SOW is signed :calendar:

deploybot: Reminder created: POC-kickoff-acme — tentative 2026-05-12. Link: https://redwood.app/meet/XXXX

maria_security: One more ask — confirm whether the 90d retention includes backups and snapshots. If yes, we need separate controls and a backup retention statement in the SOW. I'll send a short checklist.

raj_solutions: Noted. I'll add a phased-evals clause and optional compute add-on rates in the SOW. Sending draft by 10:00 PT tomorrow.
